'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[custom]] implementation of the game of the same name. First released on September 28th,
2026, the implementation locks heroes and cards behind [[items]] from the [[multiworld]], and sends checks for
reaching days, winning fights and finishing 10-win runs.

The Bazaar is an online-only game, so the implementation does not modify it. A client (The Bazaar Client) reads
the log file the game writes and, read-only, part of the game's memory, and withholds checks while the player
breaks a lock. It runs on Windows only.

== Resources ==
* Download, setup guide and changelog: [https://github.com/sfleming4587/BazaarArchipelago GitHub]
* Game page (checks, logic, items, rules): [https://github.com/sfleming4587/BazaarArchipelago/blob/main/bazaar/docs/en_The%20Bazaar.md GitHub]
* The client has its own built-in tracker (no [[PopTracker]] pack).

== Differences from vanilla ==
* The player starts with one hero; the others are items.
* Most cards merchants sell are locked until received. Each hero keeps a set of Bronze starter cards (20 by
  default) that are never locked.
* Nothing in the game changes: locks are enforced by the client, which blocks all checks while the player plays a
  locked hero or holds a locked card, until the card is sold.

== Features ==
=== Goal ===
A 10-win run with a set number of different heroes (<code>heroes_required</code>, 3 by default).

=== Checks ===
For each hero, for each day up to <code>max_day</code> (13 by default, at most 16):
* reaching the day;
* winning that day's PvP fight (<code>pvp_win_checks</code>);
* beating a monster of each rarity that day's monsters can have (<code>monster_checks</code>).
Plus a 10-win run with each hero.

=== Items ===
* Hero unlocks, one per hero.
* Single card unlocks, and optionally one item per original hero expansion pack that unlocks all of its cards.
* Legendary Items and Expedition Tickets unlocks.
* '''Sell Trap''' (trap): the player must sell a random item they hold within a few days, or checks are blocked.
* '''Lock Bypass''': lets the player keep one locked card for the rest of a run.

=== Client ===
* Red padlocks on every locked card the player is offered (shops, level-ups, loot, events) and in the stash.
* A Shop Guide with pictures of the cards on offer and everything a merchant can stock, locked cards crossed out.
* A panel on the main menu with every hero's checks, warning when the picked hero (or Random) can't be played.
* A built-in tracker, and [[DeathLink]] (sent when a run is lost; optionally on concede).

== Guides and tips ==
* The game's display mode must be '''Fullscreen Window''' (the default) or windowed for the client's overlay to show.
* <code>duplicate_all_cards</code> gives every locked card a second copy in the multiworld, for a gentler game.
* If the player missed checks while the client was closed, the client reads them from the game's log on its next
  connection.
